name_note: GTDB places this organism in the genus Alloprevotella, while the genomes assigned to it carry the NCBI and literature name Prevotellamassilia timonensis.

sentences.text: Prevotellamassilia timonensis is a bacterium of the family Prevotellaceae, described from a strain isolated from stool samples of a 45-year-old patient.
In women with gestational diabetes mellitus, a study reported that the abundance of Prevotellamassilia species changed after a diet and exercise intervention.
A Mendelian randomization study using genome-wide association data reported the genus Prevotellamassilia among taxa causally linked to a higher risk of heart failure.
In mice exposed to chronic restraint stress, a study reported Prevotellamassilia timonensis as positively associated with myelin integrity and behavioural improvement under intermittent fasting.
